name: comp-48
blurb: Card expiry date input with MM/YY formatting.
description: An expiry date input using react-payment-inputs getExpiryDateProps() which automatically formats input as MM/YY.
use_when: Payment forms as part of a complete card entry flow.
avoid_when: You need custom expiry date validation or want to avoid the library dependency.
a11y: Label linked to input. No icon. Formatting is transparent to the user.
